title: Clearer control names
description: A small accessibility fix for people who use screen readers or voice control.
changes: Buttons and links now have accessible names that contain the text you see on screen, so voice commands like "click Search" match what is displayed.

title: Guides to the Myths Behind the Story
description: Three new guide pages answer common questions about Greek and Norse mythology, and one deity entry was corrected.
changes: Added guide pages for the Greek gods family tree, a Greek and Roman gods chart, and Valhalla versus Folkvangr
Removed a wrong label from the Freyja entry

title: Accessibility and Newsletter Reliability
description: Fixes to the search dialog and to how newsletter confirmations and unsubscribes are recorded.
changes: The search dialog input now has a name for screen readers
Newsletter confirmations and unsubscribes are now recorded reliably when they arrive at the same moment

title: Connections, Artwork and Sources
description: New ways to browse figures, trace how they are related and check where a claim comes from.
changes: Deity pages can be browsed by grouped categories
The family tree shows a connection path between two figures
Museum artwork opens in a keyboard-accessible inspector with object details
Journey maps keep working without JavaScript or map tiles, and the Odyssey journey links to source locators
Relationship notes show passage evidence where a source has been checked, and not every relationship has one yet

title: Audio, Better Search and an Illustrated Atlas
description: Hear names and stories, find figures with fewer misses, and see the atlas in a new visual style.
changes: Added recorded name pronunciations for many deities and heroes, with the browser voice as a fallback
Added narration for five stories: the Aeneid, Mahabharata, Ramayana, Epic of Gilgamesh and Cath Maige Tuired
Added ambient sound for eight more traditions
Search now matches multi-word queries such as "norse god of war" and related words such as "dead" and "death"
Search covers more cited works, and more citations link to the atlas page for that text
Bookmarks now cover creatures, artifacts and places
Entry pages end with a Keep exploring block, and /newsletter shows a sample weekly issue
New brand mark, and an engraved star chart behind headers in place of the old glow
Progress on a learning streak is kept across midnight

title: Search Fixes and Lighter Fonts
description: Search now finds the figure you typed, including names with accents.
changes: An exact name now ranks first in search, so Hera no longer lists Heracles above her
Names with accents or special letters can be found by plain spelling, such as Cu Chulainn and Vainamoinen
Fixed heading order on the deities and heroes pages
The Source Sans 3 body font is split by language range, so pages download only the characters they need

title: Atlas Overhaul
description: A redesign of the whole atlas, with more traditions and answers from the Oracle that cite their sources.
changes: Redesigned the site with a new grid, type scale and engraved plates for entries
The Oracle cites Atlas pages and sources in its answers
Added more traditions and expanded entries
Added guides for Percy Jackson, the Odyssey and Hades II, and /gods-of pages
Added a daily quiz and a newsletter sign-up
Bespoke artwork replaces placeholder plates, and the Greek pantheon has a new hero image
Navigation was consolidated, and old links redirect to the new pages
Fixed overlapping tradition labels on the star map

title: Learning Intelligence & Smart Search
description: Major learning system update with streak freezes, background sync, personalized learning paths, and AI-powered smart search across all mythology content.
changes: Added streak freeze system to protect daily learning streaks
Implemented background sync for offline progress tracking
Created personalized learning paths based on user interests
Added smart search with fuzzy matching and relevance ranking
Enhanced progress tracking with detailed analytics

title: Mesopotamian Pantheon
description: Expanded our mythology coverage with the complete Mesopotamian pantheon, featuring Sumerian, Babylonian, and Assyrian deities with rich biographical content.
changes: Added 20+ Mesopotamian deities including Anu, Enlil, Enki, and Ishtar
Created 5 Mesopotamian mythology stories
Added cuneiform-inspired visual styling for Mesopotamian content
Included Epic of Gilgamesh as featured story
Cross-linked Mesopotamian influences on Greek and Egyptian myths

title: Mega Enhancement Release
description: A comprehensive update with 22 features spanning content expansion, learning improvements, and visualization upgrades.
changes: Added interactive knowledge graph with force-directed visualization
Implemented spaced repetition system for flashcard reviews
Created daily review sessions with optimized card scheduling
Added weekly challenges with XP rewards
Enhanced family tree with D3-powered interactive diagrams
Added audio narration support for stories

title: Cross-Cultural Connections
description: Major update focusing on comparative mythology, accessibility improvements, and interactive storytelling features.
changes: Added cross-pantheon deity comparison tool
Implemented parallel myth detection and linking
Created accessible keyboard navigation throughout
Added screen reader optimizations with ARIA labels
Introduced branching interactive stories

title: Content Expansion
description: Massive content update with 15 new stories, 46 expanded deity biographies, and enhanced cross-pantheon linking.
changes: Added 15 new mythology stories across all pantheons
Expanded 46 deity biographies with detailed lore
Enhanced cross-pantheon relationship links
Added myth variant sections showing regional differences
Improved source citations and scholarly references

title: Gamification System
description: Introduced a complete gamification system with progress tracking, achievements, streaks, and XP rewards to make learning mythology more engaging.
changes: Added XP and leveling system
Created 20+ achievements across discovery, exploration, and mastery
Implemented daily visit streaks with rewards
Added progress dashboard with statistics
Created weekly challenge system
